One of the most amazing Vietnamese restaurant in Hanoi!!
Feb 2020
Really impressed with Bánh xèo – the unique pancake of Vietnamese cuisine in this cosy restaurant!! Don’t forget to try Spring shrimp rolls and dip it in the flavorful sauce. A must-go place for Vietnamese food lovers right in the heart of Hanoi. Accomodating staff with excellent service. Definitely comeback for more delicious dishes !

Vietnam food got me good
Jan 2020
Food was exquisite! Everything is appealing to the eyes and very well-presented. What you see is what you get! I would highly recommend the Beef fried rice with salted vegetables and the Yoghurt with lemon smoothie both are provided in generous servings. Above all, excellent service and staffs are approachable!
